import heapq

def min_partition_sum(n, c, a):
    # Initialize the prefix sum array
    prefix_sum = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        prefix_sum[i + 1] = prefix_sum[i] + a[i]

    # Initialize the dp array
    dp = [float('inf')] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 0

    # Use a min-heap to keep track of the smallest elements
    min_heap = []

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        # Add the current element to the heap
        heapq.heappush(min_heap, a[i - 1])

        # If the heap size exceeds c, remove the smallest element
        if len(min_heap) > c:
            heapq.heappop(min_heap)

        # Calculate the sum of the current subarray
        current_sum = prefix_sum[i]

        # Calculate the sum of the smallest floor(k/c) elements
        smallest_sum = sum(min_heap)

        # Update the dp array
